subject: Alpine Labs connector — governance, billing & certification roadmap
messages:
From: Lucy Tran <lucy@alpinelabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@alpinelabs.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Alpine Labs x Redwood — connector integration brief and certification question

Hi Jonas,

Nice to meet you — I lead Integrations at Alpine Labs. We’ve built a lightweight Connector SDK for LangChain and LlamaIndex plugins that several ISVs are adopting. We’re exploring an official integration and certification with Redwood so customers can enable the Alpine connector from the Redwood Console and, ideally, list the connector on our marketplace and co-sell materials.

High-level asks:
- What are Redwood’s certification prerequisites for third-party connectors (security, testing, docs)?
- How do you typically handle billing when a partner connector is used in a hosted flow (do customers get a combined bill, or is it partner-managed)?
- Any preferred integration patterns for runtime tracing and prompt telemetry so our SDK signals show up in Redwood’s observability?

I attached a short integration brief. Tim Wilson (cc’d on future replies) will be our technical lead. Could we set a 30–45 minute scoping call next week?

Thanks,
Lucy Tran
Head of Integrations, Alpine Labs
[Attachment: alpine-integration-brief.pdf (PDF)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Tran <lucy@alpinelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alpine Labs x Redwood — connector integration brief and certification question

Hi Lucy — great to hear from you and thanks for the brief. I’ve looped in Marissa (partner engineering) and Vanessa (ecosystem) so we can scope this correctly.

Quick answers up front:
- Certification: we run a 4-step partner certification (security questionnaire, integration smoke tests, sample app validation, docs & UX verification). SOC2 artifacts speed the security review.
- Billing: we support both patterns. For hosted API calls through Redwood the typical flow is a combined billing experience (Redwood bills and remits to partner under a commercial agreement). For on-prem/dedicated deployments partners often take care of licensing directly.
- Tracing/telemetry: we prefer standard OpenTelemetry spans emitted by SDKs; for prompt-level observability we accept a lightweight trace hook spec (we can share our trace adapter spec).

Can you share a technical contact and a convenient time for a scoping call? I attached our partner intake form and a short pre-cert checklist so we can get boots on the ground quickly.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-partner-intake-form.docx (DOCX)]
From: Lucy Tran <lucy@alpinelabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Wilson <tim.wilson@alpinelabs.com>, partners@alpinelabs.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alpine Labs x Redwood — connector integration brief and certification question

Thanks Jonas — Tim is on the thread (technical lead). We reviewed Redwood’s checklist and started filling it out; attaching our SSO/SSOC docs and an initial answers doc.

On billing: our customers typically prefer a single bill, but several enterprise accounts ask for partner-managed licensing. We’d like to understand Redwood’s revenue share defaults and any programmatic billing integration (e.g., marketplace SKU flow or catalog onboarding).

We’re available for a scoping call Tue/Wed morning PST next week.

Regards,
Lucy
[Attachment: alpine-ssoc-setup.pdf (PDF)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Alpine Labs prep — proposed MAP and owners

Team — quick internal note before the scoping call:

Summary: Alpine looks like a high-value ISV partner (LangChain/LlamaIndex connector + marketplace ambitions). They’re asking for certification + billing model guidance + telemetry hooks.

Suggested owners and next steps:
- Partner Engineering (Marissa) — run the integration smoke tests and review trace adapter compatibility.
- Partnerships (Jonas) — commercial terms and co-sell motion.
- Ecosystem/Go-to-Market (Vanessa) — marketplace listing guidelines and joint collateral.
- Sales Ops (Ben) — price / marketplace SKU mapping and billing flow options.

Draft timeline (6 weeks):
1) Week 1: intake form + security docs (completed by partner)
2) Week 2: smoke tests + trace adapter trial (partner + partner-eng)
3) Week 3–4: billing model & marketplace SKU setup (Sales Ops + Legal)
4) Week 5: docs/UX review and marketing collateral prep
5) Week 6: certification signoff and dual-listing kickoff

What I need from you: Ben — can you sketch the typical revenue-share and SKU onboarding steps we’d present? Jonas — I’ll prepare a technical checklist for Tim. Vanessa — want to draft a co-marketing template?

Marissa
Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Tran <lucy@alpinelabs.com>
Cc: Tim Wilson <tim.wilson@alpinelabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alpine Labs x Redwood — connector integration brief and certification question

Lucy / Tim — thanks. Proposed scoping call: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 at 10:00 AM PST (30 min). I’ve added Marissa and Ben to cover technical and billing questions.

Pre-call asks (to speed the meeting):
- Tim: can you confirm whether your connector currently emits OpenTelemetry spans or if we should rely on a small shim?
- Lucy: please indicate whether you prefer Redwood-managed billing (single invoice to customer with remittance) or partner-managed billing. We can present the two options and typical implications.

I’m attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) link with proposed deliverables and owners. If that looks fine we’ll finalize during the call.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cRedwood-Alpine-MAP-draft

Looking forward to the call — agenda will be: 1) integration surface & tracing, 2) security checklist/Artifacts, 3) billing & marketplace flow, 4) timeline and owners.

Best,
Jonas

Attached is our completed security questionnaire and a short answers doc. Our legal team will need to review the billing options, but Alpine prefers Redwood-managed billing for hosted customers where possible — we’ll note exceptions for enterprise direct contracts.

HubSpot Deal: HSP-ALP-1182 (shared for tracking).

See you on Tue.
